items.title: Book a study room
items.description: Students and staff find and book library study rooms themselves.

items.title: Sign in with a college account
items.description: As a student or member of staff, I want to sign in with my existing college account, so that I do not need a separate login to book a room.

criteria.text: A student or member of staff can sign in using their existing college account.

citations.quote: sign in with their existing college account

items.title: Search for and book a one-off slot
items.description: As a signed-in user, I want to search for a free study room and book a one-off slot, so that I have a room for a study session.

criteria.text: A signed-in user can search rooms by date, time and capacity.

citations.quote: search rooms by date, time and capacity

criteria.text: When a user books a room that is already booked for an overlapping time, the booking is refused.

citations.quote: reject an overlapping booking for the same room

criteria.text: A booking can last up to 4 hours.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours.

criteria.text: After a successful booking the user sees a confirmation with the room, date and time.

assumptions: Rooms are the 24 group-study rooms in the library.

items.title: Cancel a booking
items.description: As a signed-in user, I want to cancel a booking I cannot attend, so that the room becomes free for someone else.

criteria.text: A user can cancel their booking up to one hour before it starts.

citations.quote: Users can cancel up to one hour before the start.

criteria.text: A booking cancelled later than one hour before its start is recorded as a no-show.

citations.quote: Cancelling later counts as a no-show.

items.title: Manage rooms and bookings
items.description: The Facilities Office keeps one view of every booking and controls room availability.

items.title: Block a room for maintenance
